item.content:encoded:
Rice Supplier, Wholesale Rice Broker & Bulk Rice Supplier Pakistan

Operating from Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki (District Nankana Sahib, Punjab), Haji Muhammad Hashir is your trusted Rice Supplier, licensed Rice Broker, and primary Rice Wholesale Dealer. We supply 50kg and 25kg bags of Hashir Rice (1121 Kainat Steam & Sella, Super Kernel Basmati, 1509, PK-386, and IRRI-6) with transparent mandi commission and express bilty logistics across 60+ cities in Pakistan. In the future, we are expanding into centralized commodity Rice Trading.

Key Highlights: Rice Supplier, Wholesale Rice Broker & Bul

  • Comprehensive Role: Certified Rice Supplier, neutral Wholesale Rice Broker, and Bulk Rice Supplier under one trusted mandi roof.
  • Authentic Hashir Rice Packaging: Heavy-duty double-stitched 50kg and 25kg PP & jute bags with digital weighbridge tare verification.
  • Complete 10-variety catalog: 1121 Kainat Steam (8.35mm+), 1121 Golden Sella, Super Kernel Basmati (Aged 12-24 Mo), PK-386, and IRRI-6.
  • Direct ex-mill spot procurement from Noor Galla Mandi Bucheki, eliminating intermediary markup with low 0.5%–1% brokerage.
  • Express 24 to 48 hour nationwide truckload bilty dispatch to Karachi, Lahore, Rawalpindi, Islamabad, Peshawar, Quetta, Multan, and Faisalabad.
  • Strategic Expansion: Preparing modern commodity Rice Trading infrastructure and electronic warehouse warrant contracts.

Premier Rice Supplier & Wholesale Rice Broker in Punjab Heartland

Haji Muhammad Hashir bridges the critical gap between Punjab’s top Sortex rice mills and commercial bulk grain buyers across Pakistan. Operating directly on the trading floor at Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki (District Nankana Sahib), we function both as a premier Bulk Rice Supplier and an independent Wholesale Rice Broker.

As your dedicated Rice Broker, we physically inspect paddy arrivals and active milling runs daily across Bucheki, Hafizabad, Sheikhupura, Kamoke, and Pindi Bhattian. Instead of pushing captive off-spec stock, we cross-audit multiple shellers to secure true ex-mill spot rates for 1121 Kainat Steam, 1121 Golden Sella, and aged Super Kernel Basmati with transparent 0.5%–1% trade commission.

As a premier Rice Wholesale Dealer, we dispatch verified truckload consignments packed in genuine Hashir Rice 50kg bags to major grain markets nationwide. In the future, we are scaling these operations into a formalized electronic commodity Rice Trading platform.

  • 1121 Kainat Steam Basmati: 8.35mm raw grain length expanding to 22mm+ in commercial biryani deghs.
  • 1121 Kainat Golden & Creamy Sella: Starch-hardened parboiled resilience for high-heat commercial catering.
  • Super Kernel Basmati (12-24 Months Aged): Royal natural aroma and slender non-sticky needle grains.
  • PK-386, IRRI-6 & Super Basmati Broken (Tota): Economical high-volume commercial mess and export grades.

Hashir Rice Bags Packaging, Laboratory Quality & Nationwide Bilty

We enforce a strict Sample-First Trading Protocol. Before placing a 5-ton, 20-ton, or 40-ton bulk truckload contract, commercial buyers receive a sealed physical cooking test sample pulled directly from the active mill stack via overnight express courier.

Every dispatch is packaged in genuine Hashir Rice heavy-duty woven polypropylene or jute bags (50kg and 25kg net weight), calibrated on computerized digital weighbridges, and dispatched with official Mandi Bilty documentation to 60+ Pakistan cities within 24–48 hours.

Explore our Pakistan 60+ Cities Wholesale Sourcing Network or Request a Free Physical Grain Sample today.

  • 12 to 24 Hour Express Bilty Delivery to Lahore (Akbari Mandi, Badami Bagh) and Faisalabad.
  • 24 to 36 Hour Motorway Dispatch to Islamabad, Rawalpindi (Ganjmandi), Peshawar (Rampura Gate), and Multan.
  • 36 to 48 Hour Multi-Axle Trailer Freight to Karachi (Jodia Bazaar, Port Qasim), Hyderabad, and Quetta.

Physical Grain Inspection, Moisture Tolerances & Sortex Grading

At Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki, grain quality is evaluated on the mill floor before any bag stitching commences. We monitor moisture thresholds rigorously using calibrated Kett digital grain moisture meters, strictly capping lots at 11.5% to 12.0%. Keeping moisture below this ceiling prevents post-packing fungal development, weight shrinkage, and heat generation during long-distance road transit to coastal or northern hubs.

Optical color sorting is executed through state-of-the-art Buhler Sortex machinery equipped with multi-spectrum optical cameras. This sorting process purges chalky kernels, yellowish discolored tips, paddy husks, and micro-stones. Commercial buyers receive guaranteed single-origin crop lots with unbroken kernel purity exceeding 95%, ensuring visual brilliance and culinary satisfaction in every commercial batch.

Commercial Cooking Performance & Daig Pot Stability Guide

Commercial caterers, marriage banquet chefs, and biryani restaurant operators require grains that hold up under intense steam pressure without curling, breaking, or turning pasty. Here are field-tested culinary benchmarks for our wholesale grades:

  • 1121 Kainat Steam Basmati: Soak in ambient water for 45 to 60 minutes. Cooked elongation reaches 20mm to 24mm with an impressive 3.8x pot volume expansion. Excellent for authentic Karachi and Lahore dum biryani.
  • 1121 Parboiled Golden & Creamy Sella: Requires 2 to 2.5 hours soaking in lukewarm water. Boasts hardened starch structure that endures vigorous degh stirring during high-volume wedding feasts without breaking.
  • Super Kernel Basmati (Old Reserve 18+ Months Aged): Requires 30 minutes soaking. Retains historic royal aroma, slender needle elongation, and dry grain separation suitable for premium mutton pulao.
  • 1509 Basmati & PK-386: Quick-cooking commercial grains suitable for daily canteen menus, employee cafeterias, and high-turnover fast-food biryani outlets.

Logistics, Computerized Weighbridge Tare Slips & Nationwide Bilty

To eliminate discrepancies in grain shipments, every truckload dispatched from Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki is driven onto our partner certified computerized weighbridges. We record exact gross truck weight, unladen tare weight, and certified net weight. Official printed tare slips are securely attached to your formal Goods Consignment Note (Bilty).

Our loading bay coordinates daily dispatches via registered goods transport companies across Pakistan. Deliveries reach Lahore and Faisalabad within 12 to 24 hours, Rawalpindi, Islamabad, and Peshawar within 24 to 36 hours, and Karachi, Hyderabad, and Quetta within 36 to 48 hours. Consignments travel under heavy-duty double waterproof tarpaulins to safeguard against weather changes.

Direct Procurement & Free Physical Cooking Sample Inquiries

Whether you require a trial 100-bag consignment (5 Metric Tons) or regular 40-ton trailer deliveries, our trade desk at Noor Galla Mandi Bucheki provides transparent ex-mill quotations with competitive 0.5% to 1% mandi brokerage. Commercial food buyers, caterers, and grain stockists are encouraged to request a sealed physical cooking test sample dispatched via express courier (TCS or Leopards) within 24 hours.

For immediate spot rate consultations and sample booking, call or WhatsApp Haji Muhammad Hashir directly at +92 333 8990883 or +92 300 2861297. Physical Office: Shop #14-16, Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki, District Nankana Sahib, Punjab, Pakistan.

item.content:encoded:
Pakistan Wholesale Rice Varieties Catalog & Grain Specs

Explore our complete 10-variety wholesale rice portfolio sourced directly from Punjab and Sindh processing mills, complete with uncooked grain length (AGL), post-cooking elongation, moisture limits, and commercial culinary suitability.

Key Highlights: Pakistan Wholesale Rice Varieties Catalog

  • 10 specialized commercial grades covering luxury dining, high-pressure degh catering, retail private-label, and industrial mess supply.
  • Every variety is available in 50kg PP bags, 25kg master catering sacks, or custom BOPP retail pouches.
  • Guaranteed single-variety purity with zero mixing of inferior hybrid strains.
  • Free physical sample dispatch available for all 10 varieties across Pakistan.

1121 White Long Grain (BASMATI): Raw: 8.35 mm - 8.45 mm (Raw) |

Natural non-steam raw white milled 1121 Kainat Basmati. Sourced directly from premier Punjab mills, this variety features an exceptionally long and slender 8.35mm+ raw grain that expands into light, separate, fluffy grains with an immaculate snow-white appearance.

Best Commercial Use Cases: Gourmet Dining & Fine Dine Restaurants, Hyderabadi & Karachi Dum Biryani, Premium Supermarket Private Label Packaging, Containerized Export to Europe & GCC. Available for direct ex-mill bilty dispatch from Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki in 50 kg Heavy Duty PP, 25 kg Laminated BOPP, 10 kg Master Pack, 5 kg Consumer Bag.

  • Average Raw Grain Length (AGL): 8.35 mm - 8.45 mm (Raw)
  • Post-Cooking Elongation: 18.0 mm - 21.0 mm
  • Moisture Limit: 12.0% max | Broken Ratio: 1.0% max
  • Crop Year & Purity: Current Season & Naturally Aged Lots (95% minimum Purity)
  • Polish & Aroma Profile: White Single / Double Polished | Medium-High

1121 Silky Long Grain (BASMATI): Raw: 8.40 mm - 8.50 mm (Raw) |

1121 Silky Long Grain undergoes specialized multi-pass water friction polishing and Sortex optical grading. The resulting grain is free from bran powder, glistening with a radiant pearly finish that retains maximum structural integrity and visual grandeur on banquet platters.

Best Commercial Use Cases: 5-Star Hotel Banquets & Executive Catering, Luxury Wedding Feast Services, High-End International Export Packs, Premium Brand Retail Distribution. Available for direct ex-mill bilty dispatch from Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki in 50 kg PP Bag, 25 kg Laminated BOPP, 10 kg Jute Bag, Custom Private Label.

  • Average Raw Grain Length (AGL): 8.40 mm - 8.50 mm (Raw)
  • Post-Cooking Elongation: 19.0 mm - 22.0 mm
  • Moisture Limit: 12.0% max | Broken Ratio: 0.5% max
  • Crop Year & Purity: Well-Conditioned Aged Stock (96% minimum Purity)
  • Polish & Aroma Profile: Double Silky Water Polished | Medium-High

1121 Brown Rice (SPECIALTY): Raw: 8.30 mm - 8.40 mm (Raw) |

1121 Brown Rice is dehusked while retaining the complete nutrient-rich outer bran layer and cereal germ. High in natural dietary fiber, minerals, and complex carbohydrates, it offers a distinct wholesome nutty flavor and firm al-dente texture favored by health-conscious consumers.

Best Commercial Use Cases: Health Food Retail Brands & Fitness Cafes, Diabetic & Low-GI Dietary Regimens, Organic & Wellness Food Exporters, Specialty Gourmet Supermarket Shelves. Available for direct ex-mill bilty dispatch from Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki in 50 kg PP Bag, 25 kg Food Grade Sack, 10 kg Vacuum Pack.

  • Average Raw Grain Length (AGL): 8.30 mm - 8.40 mm (Raw)
  • Post-Cooking Elongation: 14.0 mm - 16.0 mm
  • Moisture Limit: 13.0% max | Broken Ratio: 1.0% max
  • Crop Year & Purity: Current Harvest Fresh Lot (95% minimum Purity)
  • Polish & Aroma Profile: Unpolished (Whole Bran Retained) | Natural Nutty Whole Grain

1121 Steam Rice (BASMATI): Raw: 8.35 mm - 8.50 mm (Raw) | Cooked:

1121 Steam Rice is conditioned with pressurized steam during processing before milling. This locks in grain elasticity, softens the outer core, and allows each kernel to swell into a jaw-dropping 20mm-24mm long discrete cooked grain that never breaks or turns mushy during heavy commercial cooking.

Best Commercial Use Cases: Authentic Arabian Mandi, Kabsa & Madhbi, Commercial Biryani Centers & Large Daig Catering, Wedding Hall & Banquet Caterers, Bulk Export to Saudi Arabia, UAE & Gulf Markets. Available for direct ex-mill bilty dispatch from Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki in 50 kg Heavy Duty PP, 25 kg BOPP Bag, 10 kg Fabric Bag.

  • Average Raw Grain Length (AGL): 8.35 mm - 8.50 mm (Raw)
  • Post-Cooking Elongation: 20.0 mm - 24.0 mm
  • Moisture Limit: 12.5% max | Broken Ratio: 0.5% - 1.0%
  • Crop Year & Purity: Current & 1-2 Year Naturally Aged Lots (95% minimum Purity)
  • Polish & Aroma Profile: Steam Double Silky Polished | Medium

1121 Sella Rice (BASMATI): Raw: 8.30 mm - 8.45 mm | Cooked: 18.0

Parboiled inside the paddy husk before milling, 1121 Sella Rice boasts a rich golden amber color that turns pearly white upon boiling. Its hardened starch structure withstands intensive stirring, high-pressure wood-fire daigs, and long holding times in banquet warmers without clumping.

Best Commercial Use Cases: Mass Community Feasts & Wedding Daigs, Pakistani & Hyderabadi Dum Biryani, Middle East & UK Food Service Exporters, Institutional Dining & High-Heat Commercial Stoves. Available for direct ex-mill bilty dispatch from Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki in 50 kg Woven PP, 25 kg Polypropylene Sacks, Custom Branded Sacks.

  • Average Raw Grain Length (AGL): 8.30 mm - 8.45 mm
  • Post-Cooking Elongation: 18.0 mm - 20.5 mm
  • Moisture Limit: 13.0% max | Broken Ratio: 0.5% - 1.0%
  • Crop Year & Purity: Aged Parboiled Stock (95% minimum Purity)
  • Polish & Aroma Profile: Golden / Creamy Sella Parboiled | Mild-Natural

B1 Broken Rice (BROKEN): Raw: 4.50 mm - 6.00 mm (50%-75% Kernel)

Grade B1 Broken Rice consists of clean, Sortex-graded 50% to 75% kernel length Basmati pieces screened during the milling of 1121 and Super Kernel lots. It delivers authentic aroma, sweet taste, and high cooking yield at an economical wholesale price point.

Best Commercial Use Cases: Economy Restaurant Biryani & Pulao Points, Staff Canteens & Corporate Messes, Daily Commercial Rice Dishes & Dhabas, Budget Wholesale Grain Retailers. Available for direct ex-mill bilty dispatch from Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki in 50 kg Heavy Duty PP Bag, Heavy Duty Woven Sacks.

  • Average Raw Grain Length (AGL): 4.50 mm - 6.00 mm (50%-75% Kernel)
  • Post-Cooking Elongation: 9.0 mm - 12.0 mm
  • Moisture Limit: 13.0% max | Broken Ratio: 100% B1 Large Broken
  • Crop Year & Purity: Current & Aged Lots (100% Pure Basmati Origin Purity)
  • Polish & Aroma Profile: Cleaned, Destoned & Sortex Sorted | High Authentic Basmati Fragrance

B2 Broken Rice (BROKEN): Raw: 2.00 mm - 4.00 mm (25%-50% Broken)

Grade B2 Broken Rice contains fine 25% to 50% Basmati broken fragments (Kani / Kheer Tota). Destoned and dust-free, this variety cooks down quickly into a velvety, creamy consistency, releasing intense natural Basmati aroma into sweet desserts and savory porridge.

Best Commercial Use Cases: Commercial Kheer, Firni & Traditional Mithai, Khichdi & Soft Convalescent Food, Rice Flour (Atta) Milling for Bakeries & Snacks, Food Processing, Cereal Mixes & Confectionery. Available for direct ex-mill bilty dispatch from Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki in 50 kg Standard PP Bag, Woven Sacks.

  • Average Raw Grain Length (AGL): 2.00 mm - 4.00 mm (25%-50% Broken)
  • Post-Cooking Elongation: Soft, Creamy & Gelatinous
  • Moisture Limit: 13.5% max | Broken Ratio: 100% B2 Small Broken
  • Crop Year & Purity: Current Season (100% Pure Fragrant Basmati Purity)
  • Polish & Aroma Profile: Air-Cleaned & Well Destoned | High Intense Sweet Aroma

B3 Broken Rice (BROKEN): Raw: 1.00 mm - 2.20 mm (Under 25% Fine

Grade B3 Broken Rice consists of fine Basmati kernel fragments under 25% kernel size (Barik Kani / Rice Grits). Thoroughly destoned, aspirator-cleaned, and dust-screened, B3 broken provides maximum starch yield and rapid dissolution for industrial rice flour (Chawal Atta), extruded snack pellets, infant cereals, and confectionery processing.

Best Commercial Use Cases: Commercial Rice Flour (Chawal Ka Atta) for Bakeries, Extruded Snack Pellets, Rice Cakes & Puffed Crisps, Infant Food, Weaning Cereal & Custard Formulations, Industrial Starch Extraction, Breweries & Confectionery. Available for direct ex-mill bilty dispatch from Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki in 50 kg Heavy Duty PP Bag, 40 kg Standard Sack, Jumbo Bulk Bags (1 Ton).

  • Average Raw Grain Length (AGL): 1.00 mm - 2.20 mm (Under 25% Fine Broken)
  • Post-Cooking Elongation: Rapid Gelatinization & Smooth Paste Texture
  • Moisture Limit: 13.5% max | Broken Ratio: 100% B3 Fine Broken / Grits
  • Crop Year & Purity: Current Season Milled Stock (100% Pure Basmati Origin Purity)
  • Polish & Aroma Profile: Air-Cleaned, Destoned & Dust-Free | Natural Sweet Basmati Starch

1121 Short Grain (SPECIALTY): Raw: 6.20 mm - 6.80 mm | Cooked:

Extracted from precision sizing screens of premium 1121 milling lines, 1121 Short Grain offers the renowned non-sticky cooking quality and aroma of Kainat rice in a medium/short kernel format. Ideal for food businesses requiring consistent fluffiness at competitive wholesale rates.

Best Commercial Use Cases: Casual Family Dining & Fast Food Rice Platters, Hostel Canteens & School Messes, Budget-Friendly Household Grocery Packaging, Wholesale Mandi Commodity Trade. Available for direct ex-mill bilty dispatch from Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki in 50 kg PP Bag, 25 kg Woven Sacks.

  • Average Raw Grain Length (AGL): 6.20 mm - 6.80 mm
  • Post-Cooking Elongation: 12.0 mm - 14.5 mm
  • Moisture Limit: 12.5% max | Broken Ratio: 2.0% - 3.0%
  • Crop Year & Purity: Current Season (92% minimum Purity)
  • Polish & Aroma Profile: Silky Polished & Color Sorted | Medium

1509 Basmati (BASMATI): Raw: 8.25 mm - 8.40 mm | Cooked: 17.5 mm

1509 Basmati is an early-maturing hybrid long-grain rice distinguished by its rapid cooking absorption, dazzling white finish, and impressive elongation up to 20mm. It delivers the eye-catching visual length of Basmati with unmatched cost efficiency for high-turnover food establishments.

Best Commercial Use Cases: High-Turnover Fast Casual Rice Joints & Takeaways, Banquet Hall Side Rice & Event Catering, Blended Basmati Retail Packaging, Value-Driven Export Shipments. Available for direct ex-mill bilty dispatch from Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki in 50 kg PP Bag, 25 kg Laminated Bag, 10 kg Master Pack.

  • Average Raw Grain Length (AGL): 8.25 mm - 8.40 mm
  • Post-Cooking Elongation: 17.5 mm - 20.0 mm
  • Moisture Limit: 12.5% max | Broken Ratio: 1.0% - 1.5%
  • Crop Year & Purity: Current Crop (94% minimum Purity)
  • Polish & Aroma Profile: Double Silky Polished | Medium

Super Kernel Basmati Rice (BASMATI): Raw: 7.20 mm - 7.50 mm (Raw

The undisputed monarch of Pakistani aromatic rice. Grown in the historic rice heartland of Punjab (Nankana Sahib, Hafizabad, Sheikhupura), our Super Kernel Basmati is naturally aged 12 to 24 months to ensure delicate needle-slender grains that cook up separate, long, and exquisitely fragrant.

Haji Muhammad Hashir provides trusted, unbiased Rice Broker services at Noor Galla Mandi Bucheki. Operating with transparent 0.5% to 1% mandi commission, we represent buyers to negotiate genuine ex-mill rates, verify physical lots, and safeguard trade settlements.

  • Independent Rice Broker safeguarding buyer interests against mill variance and price speculation.
  • Transparent 0.5%–1% mandi brokerage commission with zero hidden margins or artificial spreads.
  • On-site mill stack auditing: moisture testing, grain length calipers, and daig cooking trials.

Why Procure Through an Independent Rice Broker?

Dealing directly with a single captive rice mill frequently exposes buyers to conflict of interest: a mill proprietor naturally seeks to offload their immediate production run regardless of seasonal moisture shifts, chalkiness, or grain variation. As an independent Rice Broker based at Noor Galla Mandi Bucheki, Haji Muhammad Hashir serves as your dedicated on-ground advocate in Punjab’s rice heartland.

Our brokerage desk inspects dozens of processing plants across Nankana Sahib, Bucheki, Hafizabad, and Kamoke. We compare live lot qualities, conduct digital moisture tests, and execute trades solely when grain specifications match the buyer’s exact culinary requirements.

  • Objective Price Discovery: Daily monitoring of paddy arrivals and ex-mill spot auctions.
  • Lot Locking Protocol: Sealed physical samples sent via courier before truckload dispatch.
  • Tare Weight Integrity: Supervised weighing at authorized computerized digital scales in Bucheki.
  • Dispute Arbitration: Prompt commercial resolution under Noor Galla Mandi standard trade covenants.

Transparent Brokerage Workflow & Fee Structure

Our brokerage transactions are documented with formal Mandi Sauda Parcha receipts. All ex-mill purchase figures are disclosed openly to the buyer, with our standardized 0.5% to 1% commission billed cleanly.

We oversee the entire execution pipeline from bag stitching and bilty issuance to truck departure, providing buyers with live photo verification and direct driver contact.

Physical Grain Inspection, Moisture Tolerances & Sortex Grading

At Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki, grain quality is evaluated on the mill floor before any bag stitching commences. We monitor moisture thresholds rigorously using calibrated Kett digital grain moisture meters, strictly capping lots at 11.5% to 12.0%. Keeping moisture below this ceiling prevents post-packing fungal development, weight shrinkage, and heat generation during long-distance road transit to coastal or northern hubs.

Optical color sorting is executed through state-of-the-art Buhler Sortex machinery equipped with multi-spectrum optical cameras. This sorting process purges chalky kernels, yellowish discolored tips, paddy husks, and micro-stones. Commercial buyers receive guaranteed single-origin crop lots with unbroken kernel purity exceeding 95%, ensuring visual brilliance and culinary satisfaction in every commercial batch.

Commercial Cooking Performance & Daig Pot Stability Guide

Commercial caterers, marriage banquet chefs, and biryani restaurant operators require grains that hold up under intense steam pressure without curling, breaking, or turning pasty. Here are field-tested culinary benchmarks for our wholesale grades:

  • 1121 Kainat Steam Basmati: Soak in ambient water for 45 to 60 minutes. Cooked elongation reaches 20mm to 24mm with an impressive 3.8x pot volume expansion. Excellent for authentic Karachi and Lahore dum biryani.
  • 1121 Parboiled Golden & Creamy Sella: Requires 2 to 2.5 hours soaking in lukewarm water. Boasts hardened starch structure that endures vigorous degh stirring during high-volume wedding feasts without breaking.
  • Super Kernel Basmati (Old Reserve 18+ Months Aged): Requires 30 minutes soaking. Retains historic royal aroma, slender needle elongation, and dry grain separation suitable for premium mutton pulao.
  • 1509 Basmati & PK-386: Quick-cooking commercial grains suitable for daily canteen menus, employee cafeterias, and high-turnover fast-food biryani outlets.

To eliminate discrepancies in grain shipments, every truckload dispatched from Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki is driven onto our partner certified computerized weighbridges. Bulk 1121 Sella Basmati Supplier for Restaurants in Lahore

Restaurant kitchens across Lahore face extreme operational pressures: high flame burners, continuous wok tossing, extended bain-marie holding, and aggressive ladle mixing. Our 1121 Golden & Creamy Sella Basmati is parboiled under strict steam-pressure protocols, locking starch within the endosperm to guarantee flawless grain separation, zero mushiness, and magnificent 20mm+ needle elongation in every single plate served.

Key Highlights: Bulk 1121 Sella Basmati Supplier for Resta

  • Starch Gelatinization Physics: Parboiling drives surface nutrients into the core, creating a crystal-firm grain that withstands vigorous spooning and deep dum steaming.
  • Plate Profitability: Yields up to 4x its dry weight, lowering the cost per restaurant serving by 18% compared to untreated raw varieties.
  • Consistent Elongation: Reaches 22mm needle-thin slender appearance, satisfying upscale presentation demands on large oval platters.
  • Direct Punjab Mandi Logistics: Ex-mill dispatch from Bucheki and Hafizabad with scheduled 24-hour freight to Lahore kitchen depots.

Why Lahore Restaurants Require Parboiled 1121 Sella Basmati

Running a high-volume commercial restaurant in Lahore, whether on MM Alam Road, DHA Phase 5, or Johar Town, demands relentless consistency. Diners in Lahore are exceptionally discerning about grain length, texture, and aroma. However, standard raw basmati rice frequently breaks or turns soggy under continuous commercial kitchen stress. When chefs steam 20kg to 50kg batches of rice in high-pressure cookers or heavy aluminum deghs, fragile grains collapse under moisture condensation.

1121 Sella Basmati solves this culinary challenge at the molecular level. Through the specialized parboiling process, involving controlled steeping, pressurized steaming of unmilled paddy, and gradual solar drying, the starch inside each grain gelatinizes. This crystalline restructuring forms a robust outer mantle. When tossed in high-heat woks for Chinese fried rice or layered with spicy gravies for Sindhi biryani, the grains retain their independent needle-like geometry without releasing excess amylose.

Furthermore, restaurant operational margins depend heavily on cooked yield. 1121 Sella Basmati delivers an extraordinary 1:3.8 expansion ratio. One 50kg bag of Hashir Rice Supplier 1121 Sella generates between 190kg and 200kg of fluffy, cooked rice, enabling Lahore restaurant managers to precisely calculate food costs, eliminate portion variance, and maximize profitability.

  • Withstands aggressive commercial ladle serving without snapping tips or bruising grain edges.
  • Maintains pristine individual grain separation even after 3 to 4 hours in steam-table display warmers.
  • Absorbs oil, ghee, saffron color, and rich meat broths without turning clumpy or gummy.
  • Zero chalkiness and <0.5% broken grains verified through triple optical Sortex inspection.

Culinary Specifications & Kitchen Batch Management

To extract peak performance from our 1121 Sella Basmati, Lahore restaurant head chefs should implement standardized soaking and boiling SOPs. Unlike raw white rice, parboiled Sella basmati has a tighter cellular matrix that requires a minimum of 2.5 to 3 hours of pre-soaking in room-temperature water. During this window, the grains slowly hydrate to 30% internal moisture equilibrium.

When introduced into rolling boiling water (at an optimal 1:6 rice-to-water ratio with 1.5% salinity), the grains elongate rapidly along their longitudinal axis rather than swelling horizontally. This produces the iconic 22mm+ slender thread appearance that Lahori diners associate with luxury culinary hospitality.

For biryani assembly, restaurant kitchens should par-boil the rice to 75% doneness (approx. 8 to 9 minutes of active boil) before draining and layering over marinating meats. The residual starch gelatinization ensures that the grain absorbs the aromatic vapors of yakhni, saffron water, and kewra during a 25-minute sealed dum without disintegrating.

Wholesale Mandi Procurement & Direct Lahore Delivery Schedule

Hashir Rice Supplier operates direct procurement networks in the fertile Basmati heartlands of Bucheki, Hafizabad, and Nankana Sahib. By bypassing middlemen commission agents in Akbari Mandi, we supply Lahore restaurant chains and standalone eateries with fresh-crop, laboratory-tested 1121 Sella at strictly ex-mill price points.

Our logistics hub coordinates daily multi-stop delivery routes across Lahore. Whether your restaurant requires bi-weekly 25kg laminated pouch deliveries for easy kitchen handling or weekly 50kg master woven polypropylene bags, we ensure timely drops right to your kitchen loading dock with signed moisture compliance certificates.

Technical Grain Specifications & Kitchen Yield: 1121 Sella

The Starch Retrogradation Advantage in Commercial Service: During parboiling, amylose molecules recrystallize into an insoluble lattice. This prevents starch leaching into hot cooking liquids, drastically reducing stickiness and allowing refrigerated pre-cooked rice to be flash-reheated in pans or steamers without textural degradation.

Cooking Protocol: 2.5 to 3 hours soaking followed by vigorous boil & 25-min dum. Commercial Holding Stability: Up to 4 hours in commercial chafing dishes without softening.

The Pure Culinary Tradition of 1121 White (Raw) Basmati in Lahore

While commercial biryani operations often favor steam or sella grains, traditional Lahori Pulao masters (Ustaads) in Old Anarkali, Gawalmandi, and Gulberg remain fiercely loyal to 1121 White (Raw) Basmati. In authentic yakhni pulao, the primary goal is not just visual length, but flavor infusion. Raw rice possesses an open cellular porosity that allows rich mutton broth, rendered animal fat, black cardamom, and whole spices to penetrate deeply into the core of each kernel.

Hashir Rice Supplier’s 1121 White Rice is naturally matured for 16 to 24 months. During this extensive aging period, the grain loses its sticky surface amylopectin while the internal amylose stabilizes. When cooked, the grains expand cleanly into long, slender, tender ribbons that absorb every drop of seasoned stock without bursting into starch paste.

The result is a pulao of extraordinary depth, where every single bite delivers pure, concentrated aroma and a velvety, melt-in-the-mouth sensation that discerning Lahori food lovers cherish.

Master Chef Soaking & Dum Guidelines for Raw Rice

Because 1121 White Basmati has not undergone hydrothermal gelatinization, it must be handled with culinary delicacy. Soak the rice in cool water for exactly 30 to 45 minutes. Avoid excessive stirring during soaking to protect the fragile needle tips from mechanical fracture.

When boiling in yakhni, maintain a gentle rolling simmer rather than a violent boil. Once 75% of the broth is absorbed, seal the lid with a damp cloth (kapra dum) over very low coals for 20 minutes. Allow the vessel to rest for 5 minutes after opening before gently folding with a flat wooden spatula.

item.title: How to Identify Pure 1121 Kainat Basmati: 5 Tests for Wholesale Buyers
item.dc:creator: admin
item.description: If you buy rice by the tonne for a banquet hall, hotel kitchen, biryani chain, or grain stockist, you already know that two bags labeled "1121 Basmati" can behave very differently in the pot. Five non-negotiable physical tests to verify purity before booking.
item.content:encoded:
If you buy rice by the tonne for a banquet hall, hotel kitchen, biryani chain, or grain stockist, you already know that two bags labeled "1121 Basmati" can behave very differently in the pot. Five non-negotiable physical tests to verify purity before booking.

1. Why Two Bags Labeled "1121" Can Cook Completely Differently

If you buy rice by the tonne for a banquet hall, hotel kitchen, biryani chain, or grain stockist, you already know that two bags labeled "1121 Basmati" can behave very differently in the pot. One lot cooks into long, separate, fragrant grains that hold their shape under dum. The other turns sticky, breaks into pieces, and leaves you with customer complaints and wasted food costs.

The difference usually comes down to three things: blending with cheaper non-basmati hybrids (like PK-386 or coarse grains), improper moisture levels at the time of bagging, or insufficient aging. Here is the step-by-step physical inspection protocol we enforce at Noor Galla Mandi, Bucheki.

2. The 5 Field Tests Every Commercial Buyer Must Run

Test 1: Vernier Caliper Grain Measurement: Measure 20 random raw kernels under good lighting. Authentic 1121 must measure between 8.35mm and 8.50mm. Blended lots typically show irregular kernels averaging below 7.5mm.

Test 2: Translucency & Chalkiness Inspection: Spread 100 grains over a dark background. Count the chalky white opaque grains. Premium lots should have fewer than 2 chalky kernels per 100.

Test 3: The 30-Minute Water Soak & Cook Test: Soak a 100g sample for 30 minutes in room temperature water. Observe whether grains split or curl. Boil gently: pure 1121 will elongate longitudinally without widening or bending into curves.

Test 4: Digital Moisture Meter Check: Never accept rice with moisture above 12.5%. Rice bagged at 14% moisture develops mold, sour odor, and undergoes severe weight loss during transport.

Test 5: The Palm Friction Aroma Check: Rub a handful of rice vigorously between your palms for 10 seconds. The friction heat releases the authentic natural aroma. Chemical perfumes dissipate immediately, while genuine aromatic basmati retains its nutty fragrance.

3. Mandi Verification & Impartial Broker Protection

At Hashir Rice Supplier, we do not rely on verbal mill promises. We draw samples directly from the conveyor before bagging, seal sample envelopes for pre-approval, and verify the truck loading at the mill gate against your sealed reference sample.

Lahore is a city where food is a way of life. From Food Street near Badshahi Mosque to Gawalmandi, why Lahore restaurants rely on genuine 1121 White Raw Basmati with 8.35mm raw grain length and high cooked fluffiness.

1. Why Lahore Restaurants Demand 1121 White Raw Basmati

Lahore is a city where food is a way of life. From the historic food streets of Old Lahore to high-end fine dining establishments across Gulberg, DHA, and MM Alam Road, restaurant patrons judge an establishment primarily on the quality of its rice.

While banquet caterers often prefer parboiled Sella for extreme cauldron durability, à la carte restaurants prefer 1121 White Raw Basmati. Natural white milling produces tender, melt-in-the-mouth grains with delicate separation that absorb gravies, saffron, and ghee without heaviness.

2. Logistics from Bucheki Mandi to Lahore Kitchens

Noor Galla Mandi in Bucheki is situated just 75 km from Lahore via the Lahore-Jaranwala Road and M-3 Motorway. This geographical proximity allows Hashir Rice Supplier to provide same-day or next-day truckload dispatches directly to restaurant storerooms and catering hubs across Lahore.

item.content:encoded:
If you run a restaurant, catering business, or commercial kitchen in Lahore, rice quality decides whether customers come back. Why parboiled 1121 Golden Sella delivers 1:3.8 cooked volume expansion and zero pot breakage.

1. The Starch Advantage of Parboiled 1121 Sella

Wedding caterers and large-scale biryani makers in Lahore face a common challenge: standard raw rice turns mushy when stirred aggressively in 100kg wood-fire daigs. 1121 Golden Sella undergoes pressurized steam soaking while still in the paddy husk. This gelatinizes the inner starches and forms a reinforced crystalline cell structure.

When cooked, each grain remains straight, rigid, and discrete, absorbing rich meat broths and spices without fracturing or clumping.

2. Profitability Through Plate Yield per Bag

For commercial wedding caterers in Lahore, profitability is governed by plate yield per bag. A standard 50kg bag of inferior grain yields approximately 140kg to 150kg of cooked food. Hashir Rice Supplier 1121 Sella Basmati regularly yields 185kg to 205kg of cooked rice due to its superior swelling index (3.8x to 4.1x).

item.title: Pakistan and Malaysia Deepen Ties on Rice, Halal Certification and Food Security: What It Means for Rice Buyers
item.dc:creator: admin
item.description: Pakistan and Malaysia have agreed to work more closely on rice trade, halal certification, and food security. An analysis of bilateral grain corridors, containerized export standards, and wholesale pricing implications.
item.content:encoded:
Pakistan and Malaysia have agreed to work more closely on rice trade, halal certification, and food security. An analysis of bilateral grain corridors, containerized export standards, and wholesale pricing implications.

1. Bilateral Economic Framework & Rice Quotas

Pakistan and Malaysia have agreed to work more closely on rice trade, halal certification, and food security following high-level diplomatic and trade delegations. Malaysia imports significant volumes of specialty white rice, fragrant varieties, and premium basmati annually to feed its domestic food services industry.

The agreement reinforces Pakistan as a reliable, price-competitive grain supplier to the ASEAN corridor, creating dedicated export channels for Punjab and Sindh milling processors.

2. Impact on Domestic Mandi Rates and Supply Planning

When international trade pacts increase export demand for 1121 Kainat and Super Kernel varieties, domestic ex-mill rates in Punjab mandis experience upward momentum. Wholesale buyers, food stockists, and restaurant chains are advised to book seasonal requirements during peak harvest arrivals to lock in optimal pricing.
